item.title: Show HN: Today's Fortune Experience with Three.js
item.summary: Hi I made a game with Three.js and AI. This is inspired by omikuji(Japanese fortune) — the paper fortunes you draw at Japanese shrines. It supports multiplayer, and you can draw a new fortune every day. If you get a bad fortune, you can tie the paper up to ward off the bad luck. Any and all feedback is welcome!
